A) One 90-minute session that covers product + a 20–30 minute security & procurement appendix at the end (keeps everyone in one meeting).
B) Two focused sessions: 
   1) Engineering + Product + Infra (45 min) — technical walkthrough and integration patterns
   2) Security + Procurement (30–45 min) — security posture, data flow, contracts checklist

Proposed concrete slots (PT):
- Option 1 (single 90m): Wed Aug 26, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Option 2a (split, same day): Wed Aug 26, 09:00–09:45 PT (tech) and 10:00–10:45 PT (sec/proc)
